description: At least 10 files appear to have been copied into one person's own folders and, within two hours, the same person submits a form to a file-sharing site. UBA rules: file_copy_inferred ($MFT: created after last modified, in Desktop / Documents / Downloads / Pictures / Videos / Music / OneDrive; grouped per folder per day and timed at the first copy) then browser_upload_inferred (a form POSTed to a site in the file-sharing category). The upload rule infers an upload from the form submission; it does not see which file was sent. A cloud-sync client copying into OneDrive and the person then using OneDrive's web page is the common benign reading.
proves: Files were gathered into a person's folders and the person then uploaded to a file-sharing site
author: Crow-Eye Team

steps.label: Files appear to have been copied in

conditions.value: ^(?:the Desktop|the Documents folder|the Downloads folder|the Pictures folder|the Videos folder|the Music folder|the OneDrive folder)$
